contract_facts: LiquidatePosition is emitted only after GMX V1 Vault liquidationState 1 deletes a position.
liquidationState 2 calls decreasePosition and does not emit LiquidatePosition, so the event is a censored subset of forced deleveraging.
GMX V1 settles against an oracle-priced liquidity pool and updates reserved amounts, guaranteed USD, global short size and pool balances; the event is not itself an external CLOB or AMM market order.
markPrice is the Vault oracle mark used for accounting and is not an executable Bybit fill or external price-impact observation.
prohibited_interpretations: liquidated GMX long mechanically equals an external-market sell order
liquidated GMX short mechanically equals an external-market buy order
absence of LiquidatePosition means absence of forced deleveraging
GMX markPrice is an external executable price

binding_model_semantics.event_identity: finalized GMX V1 position deletion and pool-balance-sheet transition
binding_model_semantics.signed_removed_exposure: -size for removed trader long, +size for removed trader short; this is exposure sign, not asserted market-order flow
binding_model_semantics.action_rule: the single HGBT and cost-adjusted structural EV rule may learn continuation, exhaustion reversal or flat; no action direction is hard-coded from isLong
binding_model_semantics.execution: all fills, costs and account PnL remain Bybit USDT-linear
